description.zh: 奇琴伊察是玛雅文明最重要的遗址之一，库库尔坎神庙（羽蛇神金字塔）在春秋分时节会出现蛇形阴影奇观。2007年评选为世界新七大奇迹之一。
description.en: Chichen Itza is one of the Maya's most important sites. At the spring and autumn equinoxes, the El Castillo pyramid creates a serpent-shadow effect. Voted one of the New Seven Wonders of the World in 2007.

description.zh: 坎昆是墨西哥最受欢迎的度假目的地，拥有24公里长的白沙滩和加勒比海清澈的碧蓝海水。酒店区（Zona Hotelera）汇集了众多豪华度假村，附近还有世界第二大珊瑚礁系统可供潜水。
description.en: Cancun is Mexico's most popular resort, with 24 km of white-sand beach and clear Caribbean water. The Hotel Zone is lined with luxury resorts; nearby lies the world's second-largest coral reef system for diving.

location.zh: 金塔纳罗奥州，墨西哥东南部

description.zh: 墨西哥城历史中心建于阿兹特克帝国首都特诺奇提特兰的遗址之上，宪法广场（索卡洛广场）是拉丁美洲最大的广场，周围有宏伟的主教座堂和国家宫，壁画艺术大师迭戈·里维拉的作品遍布其中。
description.en: Built on the ruins of Aztec Tenochtitlan, Mexico City's historic centre centres on the Zocalo, Latin America's largest plaza, flanked by a magnificent cathedral and National Palace adorned with Diego Rivera murals.
